messages: Maya Patel: Heads-up — found a broken anchor in the runtime guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#tuning 404. Who owns runtime docs atm? Jon Rivera: I own the runtime guide. Thanks for the ping @Maya Patel. Can you paste the exact failing anchor or the snippet where it should point? Maya Patel: The anchor is 'tuning' at the end of that URL. In the doc there's a header 'KV cache tuning' that looks like it was renamed to 'KV caching: tuning' so the slug changed. Docs Bot: doclink-scan: Detected 404 on /runtime/kv-cache#tuning (first seen 2024-09-02). Reporting to #eng. :robot_face: Lucas Chen: I can handle a small redirect or the anchor fix. If it's just a header slug change I can open a 1-line PR. Debra Singh: Priority? This shows up in the oncall runbook, so would prefer a patch today if possible. Jon Rivera: Low risk. If Lucas opens a tiny PR I'll review and merge. @Lucas Chen please include the runbook link so we can backfill. Lucas Chen: plan: add frag id to header and also add a tiny alias redirect in the runtime frontmatter. Quick sed I used locally: sed -i "s/## KV caching: tuning/## KV caching: tuning\n\n/" docs/runtime/kv-cache.md I'll open PR with that and a short test. Maya Patel: :thumbsup: thanks! I'll run the runbook smoke once merged. Lucas Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7123 — added anchor + frontmatter redirect. Requesting review from @Jon Rivera. Jon Rivera: Reviewing in a bit, aiming to merge before EOD. Thanks all.
